Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is __removably and replaceably__ securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.  

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is __initially__ deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being __less than or equal to__ the first quantity.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion, __including--but not limited to--textured patterns, ridges, or other protrusions__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially free of __projecting__ protrusions extending therefrom.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar __across its entire area__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion __and securing the ring portion in a snug fit around the finger_.
